A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on…

translations.web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
translations.bsb: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
translations.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
translations.asv: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens; And by his power he guided the south wind.
